subject: Medford-Malden Thanksgiving Football Rivalry
overview: Chris Murphy, President of the Medford Football Association, discussed the history and upcoming 137th meeting of the Medford-Malden Thanksgiving football rivalry. The conversation highlighted the team's current successful season and the local significance of the tradition.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Personal History
items.summary: Chris Murphy described his background with Medford football and his ten-year tenure as President of the Medford Football Association.

items.title: History of the Medford-Malden Rivalry
items.summary: Murphy detailed the rivalry's history dating back to 1889, including its official Thanksgiving designation in 1899 and past venues such as Gillis Field and Fenway Park.

items.title: 2024 Season Performance and Individual Records
items.summary: The discussion reviewed the team's current five-game winning streak and individual achievements, including records set by league MVP Justin Marino and kicker Brianna Cerullo.

items.title: Thanksgiving Game Logistics and Fundraising
items.summary: Logistics were provided for the upcoming 10:00 AM game in Malden alongside information regarding booster club fundraising efforts and ticket sales.
